title: The Nihilist Reading Of Rise of the Robots: The Novel #Shorts
description:
Strip Rise of the Robots: The Novel of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. Rise of the Robots is a fighting game released by Time Warner Interactive in 1994. Originally developed for the Amiga and MS-DOS compatible operating systems by Mirage's Instinct Design, it was ported to video game consoles, including the Super NES, Mega Drive, and 3DO.

Nobody designed the part of Rise of the Robots: The Novel you experience — it was inherited. In hindsight, it's obvious that nothing could look that good (and Rise of the Robots certainly looked really good) and simultaneously offer great gameplay ... In 2014, GamesRadar staff named Rise of the Robots the 100th worst video game ever made.
